summary: The sparse-pid trim probe failed in the harness, not the target: the pump translated a receiver pid into nodes[pid-1], so a message to pid 5 panicked past the three-node vector before any event. Recorded that failed execution as an unresolved probe defect (no target evidence), fixed routing to resolve the destination slot by get_pid, and requested a successor execution of the same {1,2,5} trim scenario. The core decided-regression, runtime decided-stream duplicate, false-Ok completion, and buffered-proposal protection records are unchanged.
